official: 市町村における東京都の事務処理の特例に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 区市町村が扱う都の事務を変更
summary: 現在、特別区や市町村が扱う都の事務は、条例で定められています。この議案では、建設工事統計に関する事務をその対象から外します。また、職員による園児虐待の通知を受ける事務などを、私立幼稚園分は特別区と市へ、幼保連携型認定こども園分は児童相談所設置区へ移します。
changes: 建設工事統計に関する事務を区市町村が扱う対象から外す
私立幼稚園での園児虐待の通知を受ける事務などを特別区と市に移す
幼保連携型認定こども園での園児虐待の通知を受ける事務などを児童相談所設置区に移す
学校職員の給与に関する条例の改正に合わせて規定を整理する
who: 私立幼稚園の園児と保護者
幼保連携型認定こども園の園児と保護者
why: 市町村が扱う事務の範囲に関する規定を改める必要があるためと、都知事は説明しています。

en.name: Changes Tokyo affairs handled by municipalities
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Special Cases for Handling Tokyo Metropolitan Government Affairs in Municipalities
en.summary: Currently, an ordinance specifies which Tokyo Metropolitan Government affairs are handled by special wards, cities, towns, and villages. This bill removes affairs relating to construction work statistics from that scope. It also transfers affairs such as receiving reports of staff abusing children at private kindergartens to special wards and cities, and affairs relating to integrated certified centers for early childhood education and care to wards with child guidance centers.
changes: Removes affairs relating to construction work statistics from those handled by special wards, cities, towns, and villages
Transfers affairs such as receiving reports of staff abusing children at private kindergartens to special wards and cities
Transfers affairs such as receiving reports of staff abusing children at integrated certified centers for early childhood education and care to wards with child guidance centers
Revises provisions to align with amendments to the ordinance on school staff salaries
who: Children at private kindergartens and their parents
Children at integrated certified centers for early childhood education and care and their parents
en.why: The governor says this is necessary to revise provisions on the scope of affairs handled by municipalities.
